probe_history.reason: The single GET returned the venue’s "Tower Social" page, whose own title ("Clowning and Directors’ Workshops, and Poetry Evening") and body text describe its actual current social-events pipeline as rehearsed readings, informal social gatherings, Q&A sessions, quiz nights, and directing/acting/movement/design workshops. A separate call-for-ideas paragraph invites the community to propose future events and lists "gig nights" only as one hypothetical category among several (alongside improv nights, comedy, poetry nights) — an aspirational suggestion, not a proven current listing. This conclusively answers the music-relevance question without escalation.

blockers.description: The venue’s own retained description of its current social-events pipeline (rehearsed readings, Q&A sessions, quiz nights, directing/acting workshops, a poetry evening) is community/theatre-arts programming, not live bands/concerts/jazz/electronic/DJ-club-nights/classical; a single aspirational mention of "gig nights" in a call-for-future-ideas paragraph is not proven current programming and does not change this. Fails BeatMapped’s venue-level music gate regardless of technical acquisition feasibility.

reasons: Real, retained Level-1 evidence (the venue’s own "Tower Social" page) shows its actual current programme is rehearsed readings, Q&A sessions, quiz nights, and theatre-craft workshops — community/theatre-arts, not live music.

"Gig nights" appears exactly once, inside a general call-for-ideas paragraph listing several hypothetical future event types (improv, comedy, poetry, gigs); this is an aspirational suggestion, not proven current or scheduled music programming, and must not be treated as evidence of a substantially musical programme.
